name: LAAOS III
fullName: Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion during Cardiac Surgery to Prevent Stroke
population: n=4770, mean 71, NIHSS AF with mean CHA₂DS₂-VASc 4.2 (≥2 required), mean follow-up 3.8 years
teachingPoint: Concomitant surgical LAA occlusion during cardiac surgery reduced stroke/systemic embolism by a third, additive to ongoing anticoagulation.

name: OPTION
fullName: Left Atrial Appendage Closure after Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation
population: n=1600, mean 69.6 ± 7.7; 34.1% women, NIHSS CHA₂DS₂-VASc ≥2 in men, ≥3 in women (mean 3.5 ± 1.3), 36 months
finding: Safety superior — 8.5% vs 18.1%; efficacy non-inferior — 5.3% vs 5.8%
teachingPoint: After AF ablation, LAA closure was non-inferior to anticoagulation for death/stroke/embolism with about half the non-procedural bleeding.
